title: Video by realrileybrown
description:
Fable 5 is just absurd.

Here: Fable 5 analyzed 3.5 years of my bank statements (108 PDFs), then made an interactive “Google Maps-like” app that plots every place I’ve eaten.

Prompt: 
Please can you look at all of the downloaded bank statements for my accounts for the past 3 years located in the folder in my downloads. (This will be 108 total PDFs)

Plot this on a site - a 3D globe that looks like google maps. I should see every place i've eaten on a map.

So parse all of the documents, and put all restraunts / coffee shops / food into a csy then use that data to make the following site.

Then deploy to vercel so i have a public link i can share with people.
